units: <cite ref="Arakhin 11a:43">Arakh. 11ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:7">Deut. XVIII, 7</cite>) <he>איזהו ש׳ שבשם וכ׳</he> what service is there that is connected with the Name? It is song (attending the sacrifices).

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:7">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 10:8">Deut. X, 8</cite> <he>לשרתו ולברך</he>) <he>מכלל … לאו ש׳ היא</he> this implies that the priestly benediction is not called a service.
<cite ref="Sotah 38a:8">Sot. 38ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Deut. l. c.) <he>איתקש ברכה לש׳</he> the priestly benediction is made analogous to service (both must be performed standing).

<cite ref="Zevachim 24a:9">Zeb. 24ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 58a:8">Yoma 58ᵃ</cite> the question is, <he>דרך ש׳ בכך וכ׳</he> may or may not a Temple function be performed in that manner? Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵇ <he>כל ש׳ ששרת וכ׳</he> every ministration which he performed before Eli was considered as a ministration before God. Yoma l. c. <he>שני כלים בש׳ אחד</he> Ms. Ms. 2 (ed. <he>וש׳ אחת</he>) there may be two vessels for one function.
<cite ref="Menachot 109a:16">Men. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>שחיטה לאו ש׳ וכ׳</he> slaughtering (a sacrifice) is no priestly function; a. fr.
